subject: Mathematics

show.line: Cut the bread into two equal parts. Each part is one half. Four equal parts? Each is one quarter!

rounds.prompt: Which pizza is cut into quarters?
Which shape has one third coloured in?
rounds.praise: Yes! Three equal parts, one coloured. One third.

rounds.prompt: The chocolate is cut into two equal parts. What is one part called? Say it.
Which one is not cut into halves? The parts must be equal.
rounds.praise: Yes! Those parts are not equal, so they are not halves.

rounds.prompt: Half, quarter or third? Put each picture in its group.
Five friends share a cake equally. Which piece is one fifth?
rounds.praise: Yes! Five equal parts. One fifth.

hints: Count the equal parts. Two parts are halves, four parts are quarters.
The parts must be the same size to be fair.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will cut the pizza into quarters.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Three pieces are thirds. Quarters need four equal pieces.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count the pieces together. One, two, three. Three equal parts are thirds!

parent_line: Can name halves, quarters, thirds and fifths of a shape.
